observations.result: the prompt bytes covered by the signed grant and the prompt bytes transmitted to the broker differed by exactly one byte, introduced by shell normalization of a trailing newline
the broker refused the request because the grant did not cover the transmitted bytes; no completion was accepted

one normalized prompt file is now computed once and consumed by both the grant leg and the transmitting leg, so the two legs cannot disagree about a byte
